scope: Independent current structural/revision binding audit of all lessons referenced by the three batch22 source-object slices. Checks exact current canonical lesson hash, complete ordered paragraph identity, nonempty target prose, term/safety cardinality, direct-Japanese draft metadata and per-object status/uncovered-facet mirrors. It does not independently approve source-object semantic coverage or translation correctness.
limitations: Coverage status and comparisonBasis are exact author-ledger assertions, structurally mirrored without upgrading them to independent semantic approval.
A lesson/paragraph or target binding does not establish that every source-object facet is taught; partial and source-qualification statuses remain unchanged.
Existing knowledge-matrix translation/integration statuses are historical and are not used as proof of current locale delivery or semantic closure.
No source pages, exercises, current standard compliance, native/domain certification or physical-device/glyph rendering is certified by this audit.
